digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, LLM step failure reporting
propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures (e.g. overlap-judge batches) are invisible in plan-review verdict JSON because failures are swallowed to defaults without in-memory recording, making an empty result indistinguishable from a legitimate empty result.

All failed LLM calls funnel through a single seam (PydanticAIRunner.run except block at runner.py:573) which writes spend logs but no verdict-visible counter, leaving no observability path from the runner to the produced JSON.

New run-scoped stdlib-only leaf module step_failures.py records failures at the runner seam and drains into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation-safety of clean runs.
coverage.llm_step_failures is shaped as {total: int, by_step: {label: int}} keyed by runner _call_label, matching log output for operator grep.
Text renderer _render_plan_review_text surfaces the failure counts in human-readable output only when the key is present, leaving clean runs byte-identical.
